name: Spytrend
tagline: Facebook/Meta and TikTok ad analytics and competitor ad research, hosted with browser sign-in
description: Hosted remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP) for advertising analytics on Facebook/Meta and TikTok. Search ads and creatives, look up the advertisers and websites behind them, and follow rankings of what is newly picking up; Spytrend adds 170M+ new Meta ads a month. Sign in with a Spytrend account in the browser (OAuth), no API key. A free plan is available.
